Application Data.NAME: Shutter & Smile Photography
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Shutter & Smile Photography specializes in portrait and event photography, providing high-quality photographic services for individuals and businesses. Our studio offers a comfortable environment for client sessions and is equipped with standard studio equipment including backdrops, lighting, and cameras. We also supply photography-related products, such as prints and albums, to complement our services. Our operations do not involve the use of drones or chemical processing, ensuring compliance with industry guidelines.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a client accidentally knocked over a studio light, causing damage to a backdrop and lighting equipment valued at $2,500. The equipment was repaired, and the backdrop was replaced at an additional cost of $1,000. The claim was processed and closed by April 30, 2023, with a total loss amount of $3,500.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system installed and monitored, perimeter fencing around premises, and regular security patrols during off-hours.
